stackDivergence.rationale: Task147 ports original SvxBrushItem Which/Color/Color+ComplexColor/copy constructor family for reachable non-graphic GPOS_NONE values, actual transparent Calc ATTR_BACKGROUND148 default, full color/filter/complex/shading/graphic-percent value state, isUsed, copy/clone/equality/logical hash and supported typed scalar Any methods. Reuse shared Color/ComplexColor/Any/hash primitives; no native memory/move/instance manager. Mutable color borrowing, side-effecting complex getter, original0xfe percent scale, byte casts, RGB alpha preservation and failed graphic-percent extraction default0 are preserved. Full original ShadingPattern long constants and brush position/version declarations are represented without pretending they provide graphics. Real Graphic/GraphicObject constructors/positions/links/URL/filter loaders, XGraphic and XComplexColor transport remain unported; their known provider selectors explicitly returnfalse. No fake image/provider/security path or browser snapshot projection is introduced; inherited no-argument query remains undefined. UI-localized presentation is deferred per user direction. Broader native graphic behavior and complete Calc pool/document/connected UI/ODS remain pending, with deliberate I/O/recovery deviations retained.
